_about: Animation overhaul, unit K: the winner in the wreckage after a KO. start: seconds after the KO when the winner stops (win.stand), stand: how long he stands spent, survey: how long he looks over the scene (win.survey, the head sweeping yaw radians each way), end: per shape key (the ragdoll shapes of ragdoll_motion.json) whether he then holds the survey or takes emote.victory.
